 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter the DOM ID for the column. If defined, the DOM ID is used as the ID for the corresponding table header (TH) cell, and as the HEADERS value for corresponding table data (TD) cells. Enter the format mask to apply to this column.
 You can type in the format mask or pick from the predefined list, based on a sample representation of how that format mask is displayed.

It is important that number format masks are only applied to columns that contain numbers and date format masks are only applied to columns that contain dates.

layout

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | sequence | number | Yes | | data type=number; maxLen=22

Enter the display sequence for this column. The sequence setting determines where this column is displayed in relation to other columns within the region.

Note: If two columns, within the same region, have the same sequence value then they may be displayed in a different order when the application is exported and imported into another environment, such as a test or production environment.
To ensure consistency, Oracle recommends you specify unique sequence numbers for every item, or at least for those within the same region.

layout {
 sequence: 42
}

layout

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | sequence | number | Yes | | data type=number; maxLen=22

Enter the display sequence for this column. The sequence setting determines where this column is displayed in relation to other columns within the region.

Note: If two columns, within the same region, have the same sequence value then they may be displayed in a different order when the application is exported and imported into another environment, such as a test or production environment.
To ensure consistency, Oracle recommends you specify unique sequence numbers for every item, or at least for those within the same region.

 | columnAlignment | enum | Yes | start | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: start center end
Applies whentype supports VISIBLE

 | group | reference | No | | data type=reference; lov=COMPONENT; references=columnGroup
Applies whentype supports VISIBLE

 | useGroupFor | enum | Yes | both | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: both singleRowView heading
Applies whentype supports VISIBLE and group is set

 | stretch | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: never always
Applies whentype supports VISIBLE

 stretch: never
}

appearance

 | cssClasses | array of strings | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentype supports VISIBLE

Enter classes to add to this component. You may add multiple classes by separating them with spaces.

Note: These CSS classes will be applied to the cells in the Interactive Grid. To apply CSS classes to the corresponding item, please see the CSS Classes property under the Advanced group.

 | icon | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentype supports ICON

Enter the classes for the icon you want to add to the component. You may add multiple classes by separating them with spaces.

If your theme uses Font APEX then review the Universal Theme Sample Application to view available icons and modifiers.

Note: This icon will be displayed inside of the item, not as part of the label.

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter the DOM ID for the column. The DOM ID can be useful when developing custom JavaScript behavior, or custom style for the column item. If the DOM ID is not defined, an internal ID is used for the column item ID.

 | cssClasses | array of strings | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentype supports ELEMENT

Enter classes to add to this component. You may add multiple classes by separating them with spaces.

Note: This property can be used to make style modifications to the corresponding item when the Interactive Grid is editable.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Applies whentype supports ELEMENT
Enter additional attributes to be included in the form element HTML tag. The size and id HTML attributes are generated and therefore should not be supplied. For the class HTML attribute it is better to use the dedicated CSS Classes attribute instead.

 | columnInitJavaScriptFunction | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter a JavaScript function that takes a configuration object for the column, modifies the object, and returns it. This allows advanced customization of the column appearance, features, and behavior.

 | initJavaScriptFunction | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whentype supports INIT_JAVASCRIPT_CODE

layout

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | sequence | number | Yes | | data type=number; maxLen=22

Enter the display sequence for this layer. The sequence setting determines the order in which map layers are displayed on top of each other. Layers with higher numbers are displayed on top of layers with lower numbers.

Note: If two map layers have the same sequence value then they may be displayed in a different order when the application is exported and imported into another environment, such as a test or production environment.
To ensure consistency, Oracle recommends you specify unique sequence numbers for every layer, or at least for those within the same map region.

region (breadcrumb)

Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region calendar - APEXlang Reference

region (calendar)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = calendar
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region cards - APEXlang Reference

region (cards)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = cards
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region chart - APEXlang Reference

region (chart)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = chart
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region classicReport - APEXlang Reference

region (classicReport)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = classicReport
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region classicTree - APEXlang Reference

region (classicTree)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = classicTree
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region columnToggleReport - APEXlang Reference

region (columnToggleReport)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = columnToggleReport
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region dataUploadColMapping - APEXlang Reference

region (dataUploadColMapping)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = dataUploadColMapping
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region dynamicContent - APEXlang Reference

region (dynamicContent)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = dynamicContent
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region facetedSearch - APEXlang Reference

region (facetedSearch)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = facetedSearch
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region form - APEXlang Reference

region (form)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = form
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region helpText - APEXlang Reference

region (helpText)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = helpText
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | display | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: report partial regionOnly

 | layout | enum | Yes | grid | data type=string; lov=STATIC

 | breadcrumbTemplate | reference | Yes | | data type=reference; lov=COMPONENT; references=breadcrumbTemplate

Valid values: html verticalReport csv xml
Applies whentemplateType = predefined

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
The report template substitution string #REPORT_ATTRIBUTES# is replaced with this value. The #REPORT_ATTRIBUTES# substitution string is only replaced in the before rows attribute of the report template.

 | selectFirstRow | boolean | Yes | true | data type=boolean

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region interactiveGrid - APEXlang Reference

region (interactiveGrid)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = interactiveGrid
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region interactiveReport - APEXlang Reference

region (interactiveReport)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = interactiveReport
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region legacyCalendar - APEXlang Reference

region (legacyCalendar)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = legacyCalendar
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z
