region listView - APEXlang Reference

region (listView)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = listView
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region list - APEXlang Reference

region (list)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = list
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region map - APEXlang Reference

region (map)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = map
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region plSqlDynamicContent - APEXlang Reference

region (plSqlDynamicContent)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = plSqlDynamicContent
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region reflowReport - APEXlang Reference

region (reflowReport)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = reflowReport
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

---

region regionDisplaySelector - APEXlang Reference

region (regionDisplaySelector)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = regionDisplaySelector
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region search - APEXlang Reference

region (search)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = search
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region simpleChart - APEXlang Reference

region (simpleChart)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = simpleChart
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region smartFilters - APEXlang Reference

region (smartFilters)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = smartFilters
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region staticContent - APEXlang Reference

region (staticContent)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = staticContent
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region svgChart - APEXlang Reference

region (svgChart)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = svgChart
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region tabform - APEXlang Reference

region (tabform)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = tabform
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region tree - APEXlang Reference

region (tree)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = tree
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

settings

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | timeAxisType | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto disabled enabled mixedFrequency skipGaps
Applies whentype in (area)type in (bar)type in (line)type in (lineWithArea)type in (stock)type in (boxPlot)type in (combination)

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | zoomDirection | enum | Yes | bothAxes | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: bothAxes xAxis yAxis
Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

 | initialZooming | enum | Yes | none | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: first last none
Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

 | showHorizontalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

 | showVerticalGrid | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: auto true false
Applies whentype = gantt

Applies whentype in (pie)type in (donut)

Valid values: area bar candlestick line lineWithArea
Applies whentype = stock

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region url - APEXlang Reference

region (url)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = url
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

Applies whenshow = true

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

region workflowDiagram - APEXlang Reference

region (workflowDiagram)

Parent: region

Applies whentype = workflowDiagram
Direct Properties:

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | name | string | Yes | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region name. The region name is required, it is used by Page Designer to identify the region on the tree view and the grid layout view. The region name is used as the runtime region title, if the title attribute is empty.

 | title | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Enter a region title. The region title is optional, it only displays when it is defined in the region template.

 | type | enum | Yes | | data type=string; lov=PLUGINS
Valid values: breadcrumb calendar cards chart classicReport classicTree columnToggleReport dataUploadColMapping dynamicContent facetedSearch form helpText interactiveGrid interactiveReport legacyCalendar list listView map plSqlDynamicContent reflowReport regionDisplaySelector search simpleChart smartFilters staticContent svgChart tabform tree url workflowDiagram

 | zoomAndScroll | enum | Yes | false | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: false delayed delayedScrollOnly live liveScrollOnly

Specify the zoom and scroll behavior of the chart. Live behavior means that the chart will be updated continuously as it is being manipulated,
 while Delayed means that the update will wait until the zoom/scroll action is done. While Live zoom and scroll provides the best end user experience, no guarantees are made
 about the rendering performance or usability for large data sets or slow client environments. If performance is an issue, Delayed zoom and scroll should be used instead.

Applies whentype in (bubble)type in (scatter)

Applies whentype in (bar)type in (line)type in (area)type in (lineWithArea)type in (combination)type in (stock)

detailView

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean
Specify whether the Detail View is enabled. Selecting On adds a View Details icon to the Search bar for interactive reports, or to the interactive grid View button, enabling users to access this view.

 | beforeRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

 | forEachRow | multiline string | Depends | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Enter the body for report rows in the Detail View.

The following substitution strings are available:

&<COLUMN_NAME>. - substitution strings for column names.

&<COLUMN_NAME>_LABEL. - substitution strings for column labels.

&APEX$ROW_ID. - the record identifier for the row.

&APEX$ROW_INDEX. - the record display sequence number.

&APEX$ROW_STATE_CLASSES. - the record state such as is-inserted or is-deleted.

 | afterRows | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Applies whenshow = true

Copy
detailView {
 show: false
 beforeRows: ```html
 value
 ```
 forEachRow: ```html
 value
 ```
 afterRows: ```html
 value
 ```
}

advanced

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | savedReportMappingIdentifier | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=32767

 | htmlDomId | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255

Enter the DOM ID for this region. If defined, this is used as the ID for the region, using the substitution string #DOM_ID#, which can be useful if developing custom JavaScript behavior for the region. If this is not defined, the region generates an internal ID.

Note: The template must include the #DOM_ID# substitution string, in order for the region to utilize the DOM ID entered.

 | customAttributes | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=2000
Enter the value substituted into region attributes. Region templates that contain the substitution string #REGION_ATTRIBUTES# are substituted with this value.

 | regionImage | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whentemplate supports NOT_REGION_IMAGE_URL

Applies whentemplate is set

headerAndFooter

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | headerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000
Enter HTML text displayed at the top of the region, before the #BODY# content.

 | footerText | multiline string | No | | data type=multiline string; maxLen=4000

Enter a region footer that displays directly after the body content, after #BODY# in the region template.
You may use shortcuts, as well as the substitution string #TIMING#, to display the time consumed to render the region.

For report regions you can use the following pagination substitution strings:

 #ROWS_FETCHED#
 Shows the number of rows fetched by the reporting engine (the page size). Use these substitution strings to display customized messages to the user.
 #TOTAL_ROWS#
 Displays the total number of rows that satisfy a SQL query used for a report. For example, Z in rows X - Y of Z
 #FIRST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The X in rows X - Y of Z
 #LAST_ROW_FETCHED#
 The Y in rows X - Y of Z

layout

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | sequence | number | Yes | | data type=number; maxLen=22

Enter the display sequence for this search configuration. The display sequence determines the order in which search configurations are searched and results are ordered.

Note: If two search configurations have the same sequence value then results might be displayed in a different order when the application is exported and imported into another environment, such as a test or production environment.
To ensure consistency, Oracle recommends you specify unique sequence numbers for every search configuration, or at least for those within the same search region.

}

label

 | Property | Type | Required | Default Value | Details

 | show | boolean | Yes | false | data type=boolean

 | position | enum | Yes | auto | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: center outsideSlice aboveMarker belowMarker beforeMarker afterMarker insideBarEdge outsideBarEdge auto none start
Applies whenshow = true

For range series, if an array of two values are provided, the first and second value will apply to the low and high point respectively. The Outside Slice value only applies to pie charts.
 The Above Marker, Below Marker, Before Marker, and After Marker values only apply to line, area, scatter, and bubble series. The Inside Bar Edge and Outside Bar Edge values
 only apply to non-polar bar series. Stacked bars do not support Outside Bar Edge. The Start value only applies to horizontal and vertical Status Meter Gauge charts. The chart does not currently adjust layout to fit labels within the plot area or deal with any overlaps between labels.

 | displayAs | enum | Yes | label | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: label percentage value labelValue labelPercentage labelPercentageValue percentageValue
Applies whenshow = true and type in (pie)show = true and type in (donut)

 | cssStyling | array of strings | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whenshow = true

 | fontFamily | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: arial arialBlack bookman comicSansMs courier courierNew garamond georgia helvetica impact palatino times timesNewRoman trebuchetMs verdana
Applies whenshow = true

 | fontStyle | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: normal italic oblique
Applies whenshow = true

 | fontSize | enum | No | | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: 8 10 12 14 16 18 20 22
Applies whenshow = true

 | fontColor | string | No | | data type=string; maxLen=255
Applies whenshow = true

 | taskLabelPosition | enum | Yes | end | data type=string; lov=STATIC
Valid values: start end innerCenter innerStart innerEnd
Applies whentype = gantt and show = true
